content: Task: classification on high-dimensional tabular data - assign every record to a class from a fixed set, when attributes far outnumber records | requires: labelled records, a class definition, and a way to handle far more attributes than records (regularisation, feature selection) | produces: a predicted class and class probability per record | families: ML, DL (regularised linear models, tree ensembles, strongly regularised neural networks) | metrics: accuracy, area under the ROC curve, per-class precision and recall under cross-validation
